content:
From 10 to 14 July (2023), the workshop Machine-Checked Mathematics will be held at the Lorentz Center in Leiden (the Netherlands):
https://www.lorentzcenter.nl/machine-checked-mathematics.html

Most of the remaining open spots are intented for interested mathematicians with (close to) no Lean experience (but there's also some place for somewhat more experienced Lean users). Applications received by 2 April (11:59 PM AOE) will receive full consideration and applicants will be informed on their admissibility soon after that.

Limited funding is available to help some of the participants, especially the most junior ones, with their travel or lodging expenses. Requests for financial support can be indicated at the registration form.
